integrity: The universal analytic proof uses elementary inequalities and an explicitly reproducible exact-rational Bernstein certificate. Finite numerical tests are ancillary, not infinite evidence.
scientific_limitations: Exact one-step scalar cubic reaction, inputs in \([-1,1]\). Does not assert invariant range, repeated-step energy descent, spatial PDE generality, or floating-point stability. An older relevant article was not accessible in full text for complete priority comparison.
title: A sharp one-step energy frontier for stabilized ETDRK2 on the scalar Allen–Cahn reaction
